limitations: Stable means the scheduler/service survives overload; unsupported/unrecoverable requests may be aborted with HTTP 500. It does not mean every overloaded request succeeds.
The Aug 30 real-PD C1024 run was stopped by the user at 560/4096 client progress; it cannot establish completion of all 4096 requests.

The archived Aug 13 C1024 server.log contains only 41 startup/error lines. Formal runtime observations are inside the raw conversation, including tool-output lines 6330/6385 (health_http=200) and 6391 (returned saved pressure-window tail); this is less complete than a standalone full runtime log.
The Aug 12 C640 post-fix log has 1937 KV-full messages / 2406 request aborts and no scheduler exception; it supports graceful overload survival rather than all requests successful.
The final abort-only CR and the earlier rebootstrap implementation are separate variants; CR_DESCRIPTION explicitly states its final OOM path does not recompute Prefill.

Historical conversation paths that no longer exist on this machine are not all recoverable as same-path standalone logs. Some were moved to archive snapshots; remote-only Decode logs are not proven complete on this machine.

Credentials were deliberately redacted, logs compressed, and model weights/build caches excluded. Restoring source uses archived base commits/bundles + patches and restore tools; this audit did not run new GPU tests.

Some reports describe an earlier saved window: final common-SWA real README says 23 request aborts but its full decode_real_snapshot contains 26; initial rebootstrap trace has 177 commits, post-drain snapshot has 324. Preserve explicit source/window when quoting counts.
